scope_boundaries: Bounded mass and a fixed smooth big limiting background remain chapter premises.
Uniform transport comparison requires a common positive lower-volume bound.
The correction uses a fixed strict analytic potential and explicit curvature margin; the reference choice and vanishing error bounds may differ between two transports.
The transport converges in L1 and capacity for each fixed original model. No new capacity theorem for arbitrary varying models or arbitrary representatives is asserted.
Analyticity of the transported approximants uses rational errors and a rational strict margin.
The converse derives a common positive lower-volume bound for the approximants before changing their background.
Background limits losing bigness or lower-volume positivity, infinite-mass theory, triangle inequality and metric identification remain separate obligations.
